source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.1, Theorem 3; Section 4.2, Assumption 5 and Theorems 4-5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3 gives a feasible locally asymptotically MMR-optimal rule under fully differentiable bounds; Assumption 5 imposes convexity and centrosymmetry for directionally differentiable bounds, and Theorems 4-5 give the corresponding limiting and feasible rules.

Theorem 3 establishes infinitely many MMR-optimal rules under stated conditions and excludes linear threshold rules under an additional differentiability condition; it does not classify all unrestricted optima.
The paper derives finite-sample minimax-regret rules among all decision rules under a convex centrosymmetric parameter space, with a randomized-rule regime.
The algorithm treats a statistician who randomizes among I decision rules, reducing the minimax problem to optimization over an (I-1)-simplex via Hedge.
